title: Repair paid reserve release and obligation recipients; publish accurate product evidence
trigger: User-requested source repair and public-product cleanup. Actual independent actors: UX /root/repair_ux, PM /root/repair_pm, SDE /root/repair_sde; parent /root is sole control-plane writer. Reviewed artifacts: ux-proposal.json, pm-assessment.md, pm-triage.json, sde-assessment.md and sde-feasibility.json in external repair process directory. Source-aware controller-attested decision; no fabricated browser EvaluationReport or full ABU-17 completion. Parent persists canonically before execution claims.
productRationale: A settled revised invoice must pay its own recipient and expose the disposition of remaining funded tokens. Select immutable obligation recipients and paid-only current-balance return to configured treasury. Payment and return are distinct outcomes so release uncertainty cannot conceal a successful supplier payment. Public documentation and tour must distinguish exact historical proof from the repaired deployment and identify AI reviews. Parent-authorized new devnet proof extends the initial UX historical-only scope without changing any old receipt bytes.
engineeringDecision: Accept SDE feasible implementation and task split, with no counterproposal, after one engineering round. New Config KNTRCFG2 is 232 bytes with treasury address/owner; Obligation KNTROBL2 is 193 bytes with recipient address/owner. Tag 5 accepts any signed fee-paying executor after paid and transfers actual vault remainder only to immutable treasury, validates even zero, permits repeat empty no-op/later dust sweep, and changes no obligation or approval state. Strict client/adapter/recovery binding and separate release state/evidence are required. Build and adversarially test actual compiled SBF before fresh devnet program/manifest/proof; never upgrade v1 in place or imply migration. Existing authorized runner supplies Rust formatting. Bounded source/UI/document changes and rollout are approved under constraints; actual task contracts and exact acceptance evidence remain controller responsibilities.
constraints: Use v2 discriminators and fresh devnet program identity with a new manifest; no in-place migration or reinterpretation of v1 state. Existing v1 paid vault remains historical state, not reclaimed by v2. Preserve legacy exact proof bytes and clearly distinguish old versus new program evidence.

Bind recipient token account and owner immutably per obligation, with configured mint and canonical vault checks. One config must pay two distinct obligation recipients and reject destination substitution. Existing exact recovery binding and stale-payment controls must remain.

Treasury-only means every release goes only to the immutable configured treasury token account and owner. A fee-paying signer may permissionlessly trigger it after paid; do not claim that trigger requires a treasury key. Transfer actual current vault remainder, validate all accounts even when empty, allow an empty no-op and later donated-dust sweep, never reopen payment or alter obligation approvals/amount/recipient. No cancellation/full-credit/unpaid withdrawal capability or claim.

Support a separate release after confirmed payment, with payment and treasury return distinct in state, evidence and display. Fresh rehearsal and devnet vault funding is 1,000: 800 supplier payment and 200 return only when independently confirmed. Unknown release outcomes remain honestly unresolved; do not fake completion, retry silently, erase payment success or add generic recovery. Overfunded/no-credit/zero-remainder cases use actual remainder rather than credit value.

Fresh v2 devnet deployment and proof are accepted within prior devnet-only authorization and existing $10 total ceiling, using available test SOL without purchase. Local compiled-program and existing regression checks precede deployment. Refresh tour only from a coherent verified v2 scenario; historical v1 proof stays preserved and versioned. If new proof cannot be obtained, retain and label the old replay and report the remaining rollout gap.

Public tour remains static with no RPC, backend, signing or mutation. Label reconstructed snapshots, mode and exact proof version. Keep supplier and treasury destinations inspectable; do not confuse account totals with invoice transfers. Preserve historical invoice bytes/hashes; a display-only buyer rename must not imply old chain evidence was regenerated.

Use Hamburg GmbH as the synthetic buyer/workspace in Hamburg, Germany; keep Northform Studio as supplier. Chapter five begins with review closed, explicit inspection restores focus after Close/Escape, and both close/progression are reachable by keyboard at desktop/390 px.

README is accurate public product documentation. Move HackFleet process research, task records, logs, memory and agent provenance to a process branch; retain necessary product transaction evidence. Update links to branch-qualified destinations, preserve history, and never suggest branch separation removes past public exposure. Retained review claims explicitly say AI accountant-persona simulation and actual isolation limitations, not human accountant validation.

Parent /root remains sole control-plane writer. All new process artifacts stay outside product and are persisted canonically by parent. No mainnet, real-fund purchase, generic withdrawal, invoice cancellation, custody redesign, human-certification claim or unrelated UI expansion.

Acceptance requires compiled-program adversarial release/recipient checks, old v1 layout rejection, client/service recovery regressions, Node tests, app/tour builds, cargo fmt check, fresh devnet transfer proof, unchanged legacy evidence hashes, product-tree separation inspection and source-aware desktop/phone tour progression. Report native/source-aware checks and any AI persona review separately from genuinely isolated blind evaluation.
rejectedAlternatives: Treasury-key-only release trigger: not selected; a signed caller with no control over destination, amount or pre-paid timing avoids unnecessary availability lockup. Treasury-only describes destination authority, not caller identity.
One-shot release flag or reject empty vault: not selected; no-op validation and later dust sweeps prevent future donated tokens being stranded.
Global supplier recipient or post-approval editable recipient: cannot satisfy multiple obligations and destination-bound approval guarantees.
Cancellation/full-credit or unpaid-vault withdrawal: unsupported and excluded; this repair only returns the remainder after settled payment.
In-place v1 upgrade/migration, rewriting historical proof, or asserting the new code is already deployed: unsafe or misleading and excluded.
Historical-only rollout in initial UX scope: superseded by parent-authorized fresh v2 devnet evidence and static-tour refresh, while preserving exact old evidence.
Calling AI persona review human accountant validation, enforced blind review, accounting certification or a security audit: unsupported.
Branch separation as public-history erasure: inaccurate; process history remains preserved on a dedicated branch and prior commits.
